tooltip.foamingshores.straight: Real waves are nearly straight lines out at sea and only bend to the shape of the coast as they come in. 0 makes every front an outline of the coast.
tooltip.foamingshores.farSmooth: How much of the coast's shape fronts far out ignore. More blocks makes them straighter.
tooltip.foamingshores.peel: The most a wave reaches one stretch of coast later than another, so it breaks along the beach instead of everywhere at once. 0 hits the whole coast at once.
option.foamingshores.peelScale: Stretch of coast each break covers
tooltip.foamingshores.peelScale: How long a stretch of coast breaks together before the break moves on.
tooltip.foamingshores.waveVary: How much one wave's size changes from one stretch of coast to the next.
option.foamingshores.travelFade: Waves fade going round obstacles within
tooltip.foamingshores.travelFade: Waves sweep on round islands and up inlets, getting smaller the further they travel past where they would normally break.
tooltip.foamingshores.wrap: Where two fronts meet (behind an island, over a narrow spit) they cross each other instead of merging. 0 merges them.
tooltip.foamingshores.wrapLag: How far a crossing front carries on behind the first before it has faded.
option.foamingshores.wrapAngle: Fronts cross where they meet at more than
tooltip.foamingshores.wrapAngle: How head-on two fronts must meet to cross. Lower lets more of them cross, bays included.
tooltip.foamingshores.runup: How far the biggest waves run up the beach. Smaller waves in a set run less far.
tooltip.foamingshores.approach: How far out at sea a wave's foam line first appears.
tooltip.foamingshores.speed: How fast a wave comes in. The run-up starts at this speed and slows to a stop, so it also sets how long the run-up takes.
tooltip.foamingshores.stall: How long the water rests at its highest point before draining back.
tooltip.foamingshores.backwash: How long the water takes to drain back into the sea.
tooltip.foamingshores.period: Average gap between waves within a set.
tooltip.foamingshores.setSize: Waves arrive in sets of about this many, give or take one.
tooltip.foamingshores.shelter: How much smaller waves get in narrow inlets and coves.
tooltip.foamingshores.jag: How uneven the wave's front edge is.
tooltip.foamingshores.jagScale: Size of the bumps along the wave's front edge.
tooltip.foamingshores.lipWidth: Width of the bright foam line at the front of a wave.
tooltip.foamingshores.offshore: How much of the foam line shows while the wave is still far out.
tooltip.foamingshores.smoothing: Rounds off the block corners of the coastline so wave fronts curve.
tooltip.foamingshores.laceCell: Size of the bubbles in the foam net left behind a wave.
tooltip.foamingshores.laceCover: How much of the foam net shows.
tooltip.foamingshores.laceWet: How slowly foam fades while water still covers it.
tooltip.foamingshores.laceDry: How slowly foam fades once the water has drained away.
tooltip.foamingshores.laceSea: How slowly foam fades on open water.
tooltip.foamingshores.drift: How fast the draining water drags foam back toward the sea.
tooltip.foamingshores.pile: How much foam bunches up at the foot of a wall while a wave pushes against it.
tooltip.foamingshores.splash: How many droplets a wave throws when it hits a wall. Faster waves throw more.
tooltip.foamingshores.splashHeight: How high water washes up a wall when a wave hits it at full speed.
tooltip.foamingshores.spill: How many columns of a drop's edge pour a full streak of water down its face when a wave reaches it. The rest still dribble a little.
tooltip.foamingshores.fallFade: Average distance water falls down a drop before it has dissolved. Each streak varies.
tooltip.foamingshores.soak: Water that runs into a dip cannot drain back out. It stays where the wave left it and soaks into the ground in place over this time.
tooltip.foamingshores.puddleSpread: How far a puddle creeps past where the wave left it while it settles. Where it reaches a drop, it pours over the edge.
tooltip.foamingshores.downhill: How much further water runs when it flows down into a dip.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverSpeed: How fast river water flows. It runs faster where the river narrows and over the shallows, and slower toward the banks.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverStreaks: How many light streaks drift down a river with its current.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverSparkle: How often a flow line's head sparkles white as it passes. As common in the shallows as in deep water.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverLen: How long each streak is. Shallows get shorter ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverShallow: How much lighter and greener a river looks where it is a block or two deep.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverBank: How often the water's edge along a river's banks brightens.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverRock: Foam churned up where a river's current runs into something: rocks and blocks in the water (even flush with it), or a point of the bank jutting into a fast current. Also how strong rocks' wakes are.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverWake: How far the V-shaped wake behind a rock reaches.
tooltip.foamingshores.riverTrail: How far foam from a rock drifts downstream before it is gone.
tooltip.foamingshores.backwater: How far a river's current carries on into still water beside it (a pond or side pocket on its banks) before it is gone.
tooltip.foamingshores.windDir: The direction the wind blows toward, in degrees: 0 east, 90 south, 180 west, 270 north. The wind is the same everywhere in the world and wanders slowly about it.
tooltip.foamingshores.windShift: How far the wind's direction drifts over time, either way.
tooltip.foamingshores.windStrength: How strong the wind usually is. It gusts and dies down over time, and blows harder in rain. A light wind makes small ripples that creep; a strong one, long ripples that run.
tooltip.foamingshores.chop: How big the wind's ripples on lakes and ponds get. They grow with how much open water lies upwind, so ponds barely ripple and a lake's upwind shore stays glassy.
option.foamingshores.chopPeriod: Time between ripples in a full wind
tooltip.foamingshores.chopPeriod: How often a ripple passes any spot when the wind is at full strength. A lighter wind's ripples come slower.
tooltip.foamingshores.fetchFull: How many blocks of open water upwind it takes for ripples to reach their full size.
tooltip.foamingshores.chopRunup: How far each ripple laps up the shore the wind blows onto.
tooltip.foamingshores.rainRings: How many rings raindrops leave on calm water while it rains.
tooltip.foamingshores.glints: How often the sky catches on calm lake and pond water: a pixel that twinkles and is gone. Shows whatever the wind.
tooltip.foamingshores.paws: How much of calm water is crossed by patches of ruffled water (cat's paws): a shade darker, with flecks of light, drifting downwind. Shows whatever the wind.
tooltip.foamingshores.rises: How often a small ring spreads where a fish or a bug touches calm still water.
tooltip.foamingshores.edgeRings: A faint line hugging every edge of calm still water (the shore, rocks, islands) that drifts slowly in and out, with now and then a fainter ring spreading from the edge. Fades as the wind picks up.
tooltip.foamingshores.wetDark: How much darker wet sand looks.
tooltip.foamingshores.dryTime: How long sand takes to dry after the water leaves it.
tooltip.foamingshores.ticks: How often the waves move on. Vanilla water animates every 2 ticks.
tooltip.foamingshores.sheetAlpha: How solid the water running up the beach looks, relative to vanilla water. At 1 it is exactly as see-through as vanilla water.
tooltip.foamingshores.foamTint: How much the foam takes on the water's colour.
tooltip.foamingshores.minIsland: Land smaller than this (a rock, a lone block) does not bend the waves: they pass it as a line and the foam runs over it, and its shore only gets a wash.
tooltip.foamingshores.minBody: Waves come only from ocean and beach water. A body of it smaller than this stays calm, unless it reaches past the area around you. Lakes and rivers get waves only where they join the sea, fading as they come in.
tooltip.foamingshores.openWater: Waves start only this far from land and travel into narrower water from its mouth. Below the width of an inlet or a lagoon, waves start inside it instead of coming in through its mouth.
tooltip.foamingshores.volume: Overall loudness of the shore sounds, on top of the Ambient/Environment volume.
tooltip.foamingshores.hearing: How far away you can hear the waves on a shore. Distant surf carries three times as far.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndCrash: Loudness of waves breaking as they reach the shore.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndWash: Loudness of the water rushing up the sand and draining back.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndFizz: Loudness of the fizz of foam and the draining backwash.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndSlap: Loudness of waves slapping against walls.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndTrickle: Loudness of water pouring over drops and into dips, and of puddles soaking away.
tooltip.foamingshores.sndBed: Loudness of the far-off roar of the whole coast.
tooltip.foamingshores.crAttack: How long a breaking wave takes to swell in before it crumbles.
tooltip.foamingshores.crDecay: How long a breaking wave takes to die away. Bigger waves last longer.
tooltip.foamingshores.crHigh: How bright the rush of a breaking wave is at its start.
tooltip.foamingshores.crLow: How bright it is by the time it dies away.
tooltip.foamingshores.crNoise: Loudness of the hissing rush of the lip crumbling.
tooltip.foamingshores.crCrumble: How unsteady the rush is. Higher sounds rougher and more broken up.
tooltip.foamingshores.crThump: A low thump under the break. Keep it low for a thin wave on sand.
tooltip.foamingshores.crBubVol: How loud each foam bubble of the break is.
tooltip.foamingshores.crBubbles: How many foam bubbles the break makes. More blends them into a smooth fizz.
tooltip.foamingshores.crBubMin: The smallest bubbles this makes. Raising it leaves only bigger, trickling ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.crBubMax: The biggest bubbles this makes. Big bubbles ring lower and longer: the trickling, streaming sound.
tooltip.foamingshores.crBig: Turns bubbles over 1 mm down without taking them out, so the trickle stays in the background.
tooltip.foamingshores.crSpread: How strongly small bubbles outnumber big ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.washLow: Pitch of the rushing water when it moves slowly.
tooltip.foamingshores.washSpan: How much higher the pitch gets when the water rushes fast.
tooltip.foamingshores.washQ: How focused the rush is. Narrow sounds more tonal, wide sounds more like plain noise.
tooltip.foamingshores.washBubbles: How loud each bubble dragged along by the water is.
tooltip.foamingshores.washRate: How many bubbles a second the rushing water carries at full speed.
tooltip.foamingshores.washBubMin: The smallest bubbles this makes. Raising it leaves only bigger, trickling ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.washBubMax: The biggest bubbles this makes. Big bubbles ring lower and longer: the trickling, streaming sound.
tooltip.foamingshores.washBig: Turns bubbles over 1 mm down without taking them out, so the trickle stays in the background.
tooltip.foamingshores.washSpread: How strongly small bubbles outnumber big ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzLevel: How loud each fizzing bubble is.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzRate: How many bubbles a second fizz at full strength. More is finer; fewer lets single pops through.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzThr: Fizz quieter than this plays nothing, so it is silent between waves.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzHiss: Loudness of the faint hiss under the fizz.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzBubMin: The smallest bubbles this makes. Raising it leaves only bigger, trickling ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzBubMax: The biggest bubbles this makes. Big bubbles ring lower and longer: the trickling, streaming sound.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzBig: Turns bubbles over 1 mm down without taking them out, so the trickle stays in the background.
tooltip.foamingshores.fizzSpread: How strongly small bubbles outnumber big ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapFreq: Pitch of the knock when a wave hits a wall.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapThump: Loudness of the low thump under the knock.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapSprayVol: How loud each bubble of spray falling back is.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapSpray: How many bubbles of spray fall back.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapSprayMax: The biggest bubbles in the spray.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapSprayBig: Turns the spray's big bubbles down without taking them out.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapSprayTime: How long the spray keeps falling back.
tooltip.foamingshores.slapFar: A wave that has run up the sand before reaching a wall is slower and slaps softer. This is the least it can be, as a share of a full slap.
tooltip.foamingshores.trLevel: How loud each bubble of pouring water is.
option.foamingshores.trRate: Pouring bubbles: how many per second
tooltip.foamingshores.trRate: How many bubbles a second pouring water makes.
tooltip.foamingshores.trBubMin: The smallest bubbles this makes. Raising it leaves only bigger, trickling ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.trBubMax: The biggest bubbles this makes. Big bubbles ring lower and longer: the trickling, streaming sound.
tooltip.foamingshores.trBig: Turns bubbles over 1 mm down without taking them out, so the trickle stays in the background.
tooltip.foamingshores.trSpread: How strongly small bubbles outnumber big ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.soakLevel: How loud each bubble of a puddle soaking away is.
option.foamingshores.soakRate: Puddle bubbles: how many per second
tooltip.foamingshores.soakRate: How many bubbles a second a soaking puddle makes.
tooltip.foamingshores.bedHigh: A hiss on top of the roar.
tooltip.foamingshores.bedSwell: How much the roar slowly swells and fades.
tooltip.foamingshores.bubAlpha: How much louder big bubbles are than small ones. Lower sounds closer and brighter; higher sounds further away.
tooltip.foamingshores.bubDepth: Higher makes most bubbles faint with a few standing out; lower makes them all alike, which sounds more like crackle.
tooltip.foamingshores.bubRise: The rising "bloop" of a bubble near the surface, given to the loudest big ones.
tooltip.foamingshores.riseCut: Higher gives the rising bloop to fewer bubbles.
tooltip.foamingshores.verbMix: How much the air gives back: a little reverb so the sound is not bone dry.
tooltip.foamingshores.recolorWater: River and lake water in its own shades: lighter, greener shallows and a darker middle. Off, vanilla's water shows everywhere except the pixels a flow line, ripple, ring or foam is drawn on.
tooltip.foamingshores.soundOn: Synthesised shore sounds, timed to the waves. Nothing is recorded.
